text: Program Description The Training Objectives The specialty aims to cultivating the practical, composite, innovative international economic and trade personals who master the basic theory, basic knowledge and basic skills of international economy and trade, familiar with the international economic and trade rules, understand and grasp the mechanism and development law of international economic and trade operation, and be competent for the departments of all kinds of export-oriented enterprises and government agencies engaged in business, management and research. Main Courses Microeconomics, Macroeconomics, Political economics, Management, Accounting, Statistics, Public finance, International Trade, Finance, International Trade Practice, World economy, Econometrics, International Economics, International settlement, International cargo transportation
